_about: Story groups shown as tabs on the menu after Jesus, in Bible order. scripts/build-menu.js rebuilds their sections in index.html from this file. A group with no games is left out.

groups.label: Creation
groups.title: In the Beginning
groups.note: God makes the world and everything in it.

groups.label: Noah
groups.title: Noah and the Ark
groups.note: God keeps Noah, his family and the animals safe through the flood.

groups.label: Abraham
groups.title: Abraham and Sarah
groups.note: God's promise to Abraham: a family as many as the stars.

groups.label: Jacob
groups.title: Jacob
groups.note: Jacob's dream, his flocks and his family.

groups.label: Joseph
groups.title: Joseph
groups.note: From a colourful coat to ruling Egypt and forgiving his brothers.

games.title: Coat of Many Colours
games.ref: A coat of many colours · Genesis 37:3
games.desc: Help Jacob sew Joseph's special coat: tap the matching thread as the needle passes each stripe.

games.title: Joseph's Dreams
games.desc: Watch the sheaves, sun, moon and stars bow in Joseph's dream, then tap them back in the same order.

games.title: Out of the Pit
games.desc: Help Joseph climb up out of the dry pit, tapping handholds before they crumble, then onward to Egypt.

games.title: Pharaoh's Dreams
games.desc: Help Joseph sort Pharaoh's dream: fat cows and full grain to the meadow, thin ones to the dry field.

games.title: Fill the Storehouses
games.ref: Grain like the sand of the sea · Genesis 41:49
games.desc: Catch the harvest in the seven good years, then share it out so no hungry family goes away empty.

games.title: The Silver Cup
games.ref: The cup in Benjamin's sack · Genesis 44:12
games.desc: Watch the steward hide Joseph's silver cup, follow the sacks as they're mixed, then tap the right one.

groups.label: Moses
groups.title: Moses
groups.note: God leads His people out of Egypt and through the desert.

games.title: Baby in the Basket
games.ref: A basket among the reeds · Exodus 2:3
games.desc: Steer baby Moses' basket safely down the Nile, past sleepy crocodiles, hippos, whirlpools and nets, to the princess.

games.title: Let My People Go
games.desc: Shoo the frogs, flies and locusts out of Pharaoh's palace before it is covered, until Pharaoh lets God's people go.

games.title: Through the Red Sea
games.desc: Keep the walls of water standing and hurry every family, sheep and camel across on dry ground.

games.title: Bread from Heaven
games.desc: Catch the manna and quail and give each family's tent just what it needs: too much goes wormy!

groups.label: Joshua
groups.title: Joshua
groups.note: Into the promised land, and the walls of Jericho.

groups.label: Gideon
groups.title: Gideon
groups.note: God wins the battle with just three hundred men.

groups.label: Samson
groups.title: Samson
groups.note: The strongest man in Israel.

groups.label: Ruth
groups.title: Ruth
groups.note: Loyal Ruth and kind Boaz.

groups.label: Samuel
groups.title: Hannah and Samuel
groups.note: The boy who heard God calling in the night.

groups.label: David
groups.title: David
groups.note: The shepherd boy who became king.

games.title: The Shepherd Boy
games.ref: A lion and a bear · 1 Samuel 17:34–35
games.desc: Guard Jesse's flock: tap the lion and the bear to chase them off and call back the sheep that wander.

games.title: A Song for King Saul
games.desc: Tap the harp strings in time to Amazing Grace and chase the storm cloud away from King Saul.

games.title: David and Goliath
games.desc: Pick five smooth stones from the brook, then sling one at the giant's forehead, trusting God.

games.title: The Cave of En Gedi
games.ref: A corner of the robe · 1 Samuel 24:4
games.desc: Tiptoe through the dark cave while King Saul snores, and show mercy instead of harm.

games.title: David and Jonathan
games.desc: Shoot Jonathan's arrows to send David a secret message, then say goodbye as friends.

games.title: Bringing the Ark Home
games.desc: Keep the ark level on its poles and dance to the beat all the way up to Jerusalem.

groups.label: Solomon
groups.title: Solomon
groups.note: The wise king who built the temple.

groups.label: Elijah
groups.title: Elijah
groups.note: God cares for His prophet, and sends fire and rain.

groups.label: Elisha
groups.title: Elisha
groups.note: Miracles big and small.

groups.label: Esther
groups.title: Esther
groups.note: The brave queen who saved her people.

groups.label: Nehemiah
groups.title: Nehemiah
groups.note: Rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem.

groups.label: Daniel
groups.title: Daniel
groups.note: Daniel and his friends stay faithful to God in Babylon.

games.title: Standing Firm
games.ref: Four men in the fire · Daniel 3:25
games.desc: Help Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego stand tall when the band plays, then keep the sparks away as Someone shining walks with them.

games.title: The Writing on the Wall
games.desc: Watch the glowing hand write on the palace wall, tap the signs back in order, and let Daniel read the message.

games.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
games.ref: God shut the lions' mouths · Daniel 6:22
games.desc: Help the angel keep the lions cuddly and sleepy all night until King Darius comes running at dawn.

groups.label: Jonah
groups.title: Jonah
groups.note: Jonah runs from God, and God gives him and Nineveh a second chance.

groups.label: Early Church
groups.title: Peter and the Early Church
groups.note: The good news spreads after Jesus goes back to heaven.

groups.label: Paul
groups.title: Paul
groups.note: From the road to Damascus to shipwrecks and letters.
